Why not use the string directly in the value string? That would increase readability IMHO.

Thanks. I want to use these string in later "hf_usb_ss_wSpeedSupported_LS/FS/HS/Gen1" mask field name. Last time I use the trick "usb_ss_bFunctionalitySupport_vals[0].strptr", but it failed in Windows.

"hf_usb_ss_wSpeedSupported" field has "hf_usb_ss_wSpeedSupported_LS/FS/HS/Gen1" four bit-mask fields, while "hf_usb_ss_bFunctionalitySupport" is a field with one of the four possible value.
I am not sure if there is a more elegant way to show them.
